_comment: Hemomancy - Blood Magic keywords. Evidence tier 2: present only when
hemomancy.esp is installed. Not on the pinned dump (2026-09-30), so these
rules matched nothing there and are unmeasured.
These are the mod's own keywords on its own effects. The perk adapter
(adapters/hemomancy.json) puts Kata_BloodMagicPower on other blood spells
too, but the scanner leaves out keywords an adapter injected
(SpellScannerJson.cpp, IsInjected), so tags never feed back on themselves.
Kata_BloodCost* sits on the hidden effect that takes health instead of
magicka: paying in blood is a sacrifice.
